proof_roadmap: 先设 IN ≠ N、IN' ≠ N'、IN'' ≠ N''。
由 depth 的 Ext 刻画（Ext^i(A/I, -) 首次非零的指标）与 Ext 的长正合列，逐度读出三条不等式。
若某个 IN = N，则该模的 Ext^i(A/I, -) 全为零，同一论证照用；同理处理其余情形。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three depth inequalities along a short exact sequence of finite modules over a Noetherian ring (author lemma at source lines 1998-2011, label lemma-depth-in-ses). The proof (source lines 2013-2036) uses the Ext-theoretic characterization of depth, reads the inequalities off the long exact sequence, and notes that the degenerate cases where a module is annihilated by the ideal are covered by the same argument because all the Ext groups vanish there (proof lines 2013-2035). The reading-off from the long exact sequence is the substance. H3.
